title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 018
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute tree and attachment variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Pine tree outline with layered zigzag canopy panels above a small base
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a conifer tree with stacked zigzag branch layers.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for round leaf or palm trees when the layered pine silhouette matters.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot is the only selected tree with stacked zigzag branch tiers like a pine.

items.depicts_observation: Round tree canopy inside a circle outline with a centered trunk
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a round framed tree rather than a free standing tree silhouette.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for plain free standing trees when the circular outer ring should stay visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot wraps a simple tree trunk and canopy inside a full circular border.

items.depicts_observation: Leaf shaped tree outline with one canopy panel and a short center line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple single leaf canopy tree shape.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the pine or palm forms when the canopy is one leaf shaped outline.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot reduces the tree to one leaf shaped canopy above a centered trunk.

items.depicts_observation: Palm tree outline with three curved canopy loops and a bent stem line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tropical tree rather than a broadleaf or pine tree.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the other tree icons when the bent trunk and curved fronds matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot clearly shows a bent palm trunk with three sweeping fronds.

items.depicts_observation: Open paper clip with a hooked top and one inner loop
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a more open paper clip with a visible hooked top opening.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the classic diagonal clip when the top hook opening should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot opens the clip at the top and shows a more exposed hooked outer loop.
